description.value: Phantom Creek Estates is a premium winery and estate restaurant on the Black Sage Bench in Oliver, BC, one of Canada's most celebrated wine sub-regions. The gravity-flow facility sources fruit from four estate vineyards and produces up to 50,000 cases annually using biodynamic farming and optical-sorting technology. Touring cyclists riding the South Okanagan's wine-country roads can stop for seated tastings, guided estate tours, and full restaurant dining with seasonal chef's pairings.
